note: Public-domain, attributed or original lines; artwork drawn in-app.

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu
quotes.meaning: Every big thing starts with one small step.

quotes.text: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
quotes.author: Plato
quotes.meaning: Starting well matters most.

quotes.text: He who has begun is half done. Dare to be wise; begin!
quotes.author: Horace
quotes.meaning: Once you start, you are halfway there.

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.meaning: Decide who you want to be. Then do the work.

quotes.text: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin
quotes.meaning: You cannot get wasted time back.

quotes.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.meaning: If you wait and wait, life goes by.

quotes.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt
quotes.meaning: Start now, with what you have.

quotes.text: Open the book for two minutes. Starting is the hardest part, and you just did it.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Today one page. Tomorrow one more. That is how a whole textbook gets read.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin
quotes.meaning: Doing is better than talking.

quotes.text: Little by little does the trick.
quotes.author: Aesop
quotes.meaning: Small steps get the job done.

quotes.text: Slow and steady wins the race.
quotes.author: Aesop
quotes.meaning: Keep going. Slow is fine.

quotes.text: Dripping water hollows out stone.
quotes.author: Ovid
quotes.meaning: Small efforts, again and again, make big changes.

quotes.text: No great thing is created suddenly.
quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.meaning: Great things take time.

quotes.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
quotes.author: Japanese proverb
quotes.meaning: Each time you fall, get up again.

quotes.text: Slowly, slowly, the egg will walk on its own legs.
quotes.author: Proverb from the Horn of Africa
quotes.meaning: With time, small things grow big.

quotes.text: Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
quotes.author: French proverb
quotes.meaning: Small steps build big things.

quotes.text: Never give in, never give in, never, never, never.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill
quotes.meaning: Do not give up.

quotes.text: Genius is one per cent inspiration, ninety-nine per cent perspiration.
quotes.author: Thomas Edison
quotes.meaning: Success is mostly hard work.

quotes.text: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.meaning: Keep moving forward, or you fall.

quotes.text: The road from Massawa climbs to Asmara one bend at a time. So does your revision.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: A bad mark is a map. It shows you where to study next.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Diligence is the mother of good luck.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin
quotes.meaning: Hard work brings good luck.

quotes.text: To know what you know and to know what you do not know, that is true knowledge.
quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.meaning: Be honest about what you know and do not know.

quotes.text: Learning without thought is labour lost; thought without learning is perilous.
quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.meaning: Read and think. You need both.

quotes.text: The roots of education are bitter, but the fruit is sweet.
quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.meaning: Learning is hard at first. The results are sweet.

quotes.text: For the things we have to learn before we can do them, we learn by doing them.
quotes.author: Aristotle
quotes.meaning: We learn by doing.

quotes.text: The mind is not a vessel to be filled, but a fire to be kindled.
quotes.author: Plutarch
quotes.meaning: Learning should make you curious, not just full of facts.

quotes.text: As long as you live, keep learning how to live.
quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.meaning: Never stop learning.

quotes.text: If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
quotes.author: Isaac Newton
quotes.meaning: We learn from people who came before us.

quotes.text: The important thing is not to stop questioning.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein
quotes.meaning: Keep asking questions.

quotes.text: Chance favours only the prepared mind.
quotes.author: Louis Pasteur
quotes.meaning: Luck helps people who are ready.

quotes.text: Iron rusts from disuse; even so does inaction sap the vigour of the mind.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci
quotes.meaning: Use your mind, or it gets weak.

quotes.text: Close the book and say it in your own words. If you can, you have learned it.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
quotes.meaning: Learning can change the world.

quotes.text: One child, one teacher, one book, one pen can change the world.
quotes.author: Malala Yousafzai
quotes.meaning: Small things, like one book, can change the world.

quotes.text: Knowledge is power. Information is liberating. Education is the premise of progress, in every society, in every family.
quotes.author: Kofi Annan
quotes.meaning: Learning helps people and countries grow.

quotes.text: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of things.
quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.meaning: How we think about a problem matters most.

quotes.text: There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.meaning: Your thoughts change how things feel.

quotes.text: Our doubts are traitors, and make us lose the good we oft might win by fearing to attempt.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.meaning: Fear of trying makes us miss good things.

quotes.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.meaning: A problem can show you the way forward.

quotes.text: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.meaning: Happiness comes from how you think.

quotes.text: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
quotes.author: Marie Curie
quotes.meaning: Learn about what scares you. Then you fear it less.

quotes.text: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement.
quotes.author: Helen Keller
quotes.meaning: Hope helps you succeed.

quotes.text: Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quotes.meaning: Believe in yourself.

quotes.text: Breathe in for four. You are here, you are ready, you know more than you think.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: The five fingers are not the same, and each one is needed. Run your own race.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Compare yourself with who you were last month, not with the student next to you.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
quotes.author: African proverb
quotes.meaning: Alone is fast. Together goes further.

quotes.text: Do your little bit of good where you are; it's those little bits of good put together that overwhelm the world.
quotes.author: Desmond Tutu
quotes.meaning: Small good acts add up.

quotes.text: A question asked is a lesson learned. Your teacher is waiting for it.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Coffee is better shared, and so is a hard maths problem.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Teach a friend what you learned today and you will remember it twice as well.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome while trying to succeed.
quotes.author: Booker T. Washington
quotes.meaning: What you overcome shows your success.

quotes.text: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
quotes.author: Seneca
quotes.meaning: Things feel hard because we are scared to try.

quotes.text: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.meaning: Your choices matter more than luck.

quotes.text: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
quotes.meaning: Big things need energy and love.

quotes.text: What we hope ever to do with ease, we must learn first to do with diligence.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson
quotes.meaning: Hard work first. Then it becomes easy.

quotes.text: I attribute my success to this: I never gave or took any excuse.
quotes.author: Florence Nightingale
quotes.meaning: No excuses. Just do it.

quotes.text: The Red Sea is wide, but every boat crosses it one wave at a time.
quotes.author: 4 · original

quotes.text: You do not need to be the best in class. You need to be better than yesterday.
quotes.author: 4 · original
